qualifier: netrin, SLIT-ROBO, ephrin and L1 receptor cues
name: Axon guidance by netrin, SLIT-ROBO, ephrin and L1 cues
rationale: All members are axon guidance/growth-cone steering via netrin-DCC, SLIT-ROBO, ephrin and L1/CHL1/DSCAM receptors with their Rho-family GTPase effectors, whereas the closest confusable adds semaphorin-plexin signalling, regeneration and sprouting, and others are tract- or neuron-type-specific guidance or filopodium control.

name: Regulation of respiratory burst and superoxide production
rationale: All three members regulate the oxidative (respiratory) burst that generates superoxide, unlike confusables centred on antifungal lectin sensing, neutrophil degranulation or antimicrobial killing.

name: Leptin-mediated control of appetite and body growth
rationale: Members are leptin signalling plus regulation of appetite, eating, food/nutrient responses and organismal growth, distinguishing it from ghrelin/prolactin, glucagon/calcitonin-family and somatostatin feeding confusables.

name: Monocyte surface signature, activation and recruitment
rationale: Members cover monocyte surface/receptor signatures, activation, aggregation, differentiation and positive regulation of monocyte chemotaxis/extravasation, unlike confusables dominated by negative regulation of monocyte chemotaxis, inflammatory cytokines or broad myeloid modules.

qualifier: epithelial/keratinocyte migration with matrix and focal adhesion disassembly
name: Cell-matrix adhesion turnover in epithelial cell migration
rationale: Members regulate cell-substrate adhesion, spreading, protrusion and Rho/Rac signalling together with epithelial, keratinocyte and fibroblast migration, invadopodia and ECM/focal adhesion disassembly, whereas confusables emphasise CDC42-driven protrusion or receptor phosphatase and homophilic adhesion.

qualifier: cardiac neural crest and pharyngeal arch arteries
name: Outflow tract septation and pharyngeal arch artery morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern cardiac neural crest-dependent outflow tract septation and pharyngeal arch/pulmonary artery patterning, distinct from confusables on endothelial differentiation, heart tube/second heart field formation and pharyngeal organ development.

name: Reelin and amyloid-beta signaling in dendritic spine maintenance
rationale: Members link reelin signalling, amyloid-beta formation/response, neurofibrillary tangle regulation and NMDAR-AMPK to dendrite/spine and postsynaptic maintenance and reduced LTP, whereas confusables are about promoting synaptic plasticity, synaptic transmission or microglia.

name: GPCR cAMP and phosphoinositide-calcium second messenger signaling
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis/degradation and adenylate cyclase inhibition together with PLC, IP3/phosphoinositide and G protein calcium signalling (LPA receptors, PDE1), whereas confusables are restricted to cAMP-PKA/adrenergic effects or Wnt-calcium signalling.

name: Cellular response to drugs, ethanol and xenobiotic chemicals
rationale: Members are responses to drugs and exogenous chemicals (ethanol, ether, anaesthetics, nicotine, cisplatin, bleomycin, bisphenol A, antibiotics, hydroperoxide), unlike confusables centred on UV response, oxidative stress restraint or amine metabolism.

qualifier: branching morphogenesis, growth and trachea formation
name: Lung branching morphogenesis, growth and trachea formation
rationale: Members cover lung bud branching, lobe growth, lung vasculature and trachea formation/cartilage, distinguishing it from confusables on alveolar pneumocyte differentiation, surfactant and lung mesenchyme proliferation.

qualifier: AMPA/kainate receptors and G beta-gamma presynaptic channel modulation
name: AMPA/kainate receptor activation and G beta-gamma presynaptic modulation
rationale: Members are ionotropic AMPA/kainate receptor activation plus G beta-gamma gating of GIRK and voltage-gated calcium channels and presynaptic potential, whereas confusables centre on GABA, nicotinic receptors or vesicle exocytosis.

qualifier: PDGFR, FLT3 and cytosolic FGFR1 fusions and mutants
name: Oncogenic PDGFR, FLT3 and FGFR1 fusion and mutant signaling
rationale: All members are signalling by cancer-associated PDGFRA/B mutants and PDGFR, FLT3 and cytosolic FGFR1 fusions, distinct from confusables on FGFR2/3, ALK and LTK alterations or wild-type FLT3 signalling.

core: Plasma membrane sodium and potassium transport
qualifier: regulation of sodium export and potassium import
name: Regulation of plasma membrane sodium and potassium transport
rationale: All three members regulate transmembrane sodium export and potassium import, distinguishing them from confusables on calcium exchange, osmotic responses and P-type ATPase ion homeostasis.

name: Myelination and nodal/paranodal axon domain organization
rationale: Members cover CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, glial responses and node/paranode assembly (sodium channel clustering, neurofascin, NrCAM, L1-ankyrin, axon diameter), unlike confusables on axon regeneration/sprouting, oligodendrocyte differentiation or L1/NCAM interactions alone.

name: Adiponectin signaling and regulation of glucose uptake
rationale: Members are adiponectin secretion/signalling and regulation of D-glucose import and insulin sensitivity, unlike confusables on GLUT4 translocation, negative insulin signalling or fatty acid oxidation.

name: Xenobiotic detoxification of ethanol, aldehydes and mycotoxins
rationale: Members are detoxifying metabolism of xenobiotics and toxins, emphasising ethanol oxidation, aldehyde catabolism and aflatoxin/mycotoxin processing, which the CYP/FMO/aromatic-amine xenobiotic confusables lack.

qualifier: BCR second messengers and Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis
name: BCR signaling and Fc-gamma receptor-mediated phagocytosis
rationale: Members are BCR-triggered second messenger/RAS/BTK signalling and Fc-gamma receptor activation driving phagocytic cup formation, distinct from confusables on CD22 BCR regulation, inhibitory Fc receptors, ADCC and Fc-epsilon mast cell responses.

name: Aldosterone biosynthesis and secretion
rationale: All members concern mineralocorticoid (aldosterone) synthesis, metabolism and secretion, whereas confusables are about responses to aldosterone, renal sodium transport and renin-angiotensin blood pressure control.

name: APC/C-Cdc20 activity at metaphase-anaphase transition
rationale: Members are APC/C-Cdc20 activation, inhibition and degradation of securin, cyclin B and Nek2A driving anaphase and mitotic exit, unlike confusables on APC/C-Cdh1 in late mitosis/G1 or spindle checkpoint and cohesion.

name: AKT and p53 regulation of G2/M cell-cycle progression
rationale: Members combine PI3K-AKT signalling with p53 stability/phosphorylation, Cdc25A degradation, CDK inhibition and G2/M progression (GTSE1, MASTL), whereas confusables centre on p53-driven DNA damage checkpoint and radiation responses without AKT.

name: Ghrelin and hormonal control of feeding behavior
rationale: Members cover ghrelin synthesis, prolactin secretion, eating and feeding behaviour and nutrient-level responses, distinct from leptin-centred, sleep/orexin and glucagon/somatostatin confusables.

name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral gene response
rationale: Members are interferon-alpha/type I IFN-stimulated antiviral gene programmes (OAS, ISG15, IRF2 targets, IP-10, activated DC signatures), whereas confusables focus on upstream IFN induction via RLR/TLR/cGAS sensing and its regulation.

name: IL-6-family cytokine signaling through STAT3 and ERK
rationale: Members are IL-6, IL-11, LIF and CNTF signalling with STAT3 and ERK1/2 activation and its negative regulation, unlike confusables on IL-2/IL-7/EPO STAT5 signalling or inflammatory cytokine output modules.

qualifier: NGF processing and proximal TRKA/p75NTR signaling
name: NGF processing and proximal TRKA and p75NTR signaling
rationale: Members span NGF production/processing, NGF/proNGF binding to TRKA and p75NTR and proximal outputs (PLC-gamma1, STAT3, retrograde, NADE), whereas confusables cover downstream TRKA effectors, NTRK3 or p75NTR death signalling.

name: MECP2-regulated neuronal transcription and motor-sensory behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 regulation and its loss-of-function effects on neuronal genes with locomotor, sensory, vocal and social behaviours, glycinergic transmission and forebrain development, which hindbrain/cerebellar development and synaptic transmission confusables lack.
